_schema: Each key is a canonical player_id (stable, lower-kebab string). 'display' is the preferred display name. 'handles' is the exhaustive list of free-text strings that map to this player (across MTGO, Melee, Topdeck, etc.). 'notes' is optional human context. Absent handles resolve to themselves — never add a handle here unless you are certain the mapping is correct. Run 'identify suggest' to surface candidate clusters for review.

bosh-n-roll.notes: local paper regulars + MTGO handle (Bosh95). Same person across all three sources.
